en.title: Shortest Schedule With a Cooldown Between Identical Tasks
en.description:
Each time slot either runs one task or stays idle, and all tasks can be reordered; two runs of tasks with the same letter must be separated by at least cooldown other slots. Find the minimum number of slots needed to finish everything.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, editorial and tests; missing original bounds and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the statement.
en.input: The first line contains the task string and the second line contains cooldown. Original bounds: 1..10000 tasks, letters A..Z, and 0≤cooldown≤100. An introduction to merging intervals that was mixed into the original page is unrelated to this problem and is not treated as a task rule.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are 8; 6; and 10, checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Let f be the highest frequency and c the number of letters that reach f; the answer is max(total number of tasks,(f−1)(cooldown+1)+c).
